source_snapshot.procedure: Open BMC GUI Security and Access > Policies and check KVM=2, Redfish=20, SSH=5, Virtual Media=4, Web=20.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 5 attended/5 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; queries generic Redfish SessionService but assumes it exposes all five protocol-specific limits and uses insecure TLS/inline credentials.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE/LOW; preserves the exact matrix, adds firmware-specific GUI/API field mapping, secure access and per-field evidence.

old_problem: A standard SessionService response may describe only Redfish sessions and cannot automatically prove KVM, SSH, Virtual Media and Web limits. Firmware-specific field provenance and the meaning of each maximum were unspecified.
disposition_reason: The source itself provides the authoritative expected integers. ED-03/15/20 allow firmware/SKU-specific property or GUI-DOM mappings and maximum semantics to be project configuration. Read-only collection can compare all five labels independently, and GUI evidence preserves coverage where standard Redfish lacks a field.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2227, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2228 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00011-V001 / ad4d1fcbb6aabf58 was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Preserve the exact matrix: KVM 2, Redfish 20, SSH 5, Virtual Media 4 and Web 20.
Bind every GUI label to a documented Redfish/vendor property or authenticated GUI DOM field for the exact firmware/SKU and record whether it is configured, licensed, simultaneous or per-user.
Use verified BMC identity, TLS trust and protected session credentials; collect complete redacted resources/DOM context.
Compare each integer separately; missing, null, duplicate, differently scoped or unmapped fields cannot be treated as zero or PASS.
A generic SessionService MaxSessions value may cover Redfish only unless vendor documentation explicitly maps other services.
Read-only actions only; do not PATCH limits, terminate sessions, reset BMC or clear logs.
No login, browser/API read, policy write, session termination, retry or DUT action was executed.

test_case.purpose: Verify through authoritative read-only GUI/API provenance that maximum sessions equal KVM 2, Redfish 20, SSH 5, Virtual Media 4 and Web 20 for the exact firmware/SKU.
required_package: Exact BMC/firmware/SKU and authorized read-only account
Firmware-versioned GUI-label to Redfish/vendor-property or DOM mapping
Maximum semantics and approved firmware/SKU exceptions
TLS trust and secret-safe session method
test_case.test_command: Authenticate read-only to the verified BMC, capture the Security and Access > Policies page and discovered canonical Redfish/vendor resources, map each service label to its exact field and semantics, and independently compare KVM=2, Redfish=20, SSH=5, Virtual Media=4 and Web=20. Record missing or ambiguous fields without inference.
test_case.expected_result: All five authoritative fields are present with the correct scope and independently equal 2/20/5/4/20; no policy or session state changes.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact provenance and equality for all five values. Missing/unmapped/ambiguous fields, wrong scope, or any integer mismatch is FAIL or execution-blocking according to the signed project matrix; a single generic SessionService value cannot pass multiple services without documented mapping.
safety_gate: Verify BMC identity, TLS trust and secret-safe read-only credentials.
GET/DOM reads only; no PATCH, session termination, reset or log clear.
Preserve full property context and fail closed on missing or ambiguous values.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, BMC/firmware/SKU and account role
Timestamped GUI Policies page/DOM and complete redacted API resources
Per-service label-to-field mapping and maximum semantics
Five independent comparisons to 2/20/5/4/20 plus exceptions/discrepancies
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected. On identity, mapping, schema or access failure, close the read-only session and preserve evidence; do not change limits to match the expected matrix.

source_conflict.reason: The source consistently specifies one five-value matrix; API exposure differences are implementation bindings, not conflicting requirements.

blocked.reason: Expected values and read-only purpose are explicit; property/DOM mapping is parameterizable.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: BMC/firmware/SKU, per-service GUI/API/DOM mapping, maximum semantics, allowed exceptions, TLS and protected read-only access.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED AS PARAMETERIZED READ-ONLY FIVE-SERVICE MATRIX; FIELD MAPPING REQUIRED BEFORE EXECUTION; NO LOGIN, READ, POLICY WRITE, SESSION TERMINATION, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
